test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bottles are jugs.

All jugs are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bottles are cups.

II. All cups are bottles.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statement:

All bottles are jugs.

All jugs are cups.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cca84c7a235a536da87bedc88d18cb17ecfbdc366da09cfe67bd4c86d8f7dcb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bottles are cups - True (Because All bottles are jugs and All jugs are cups, so all bottles are cups).

ii. All cups are bottles - False (it can be possible not definite).

Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
